The local JSON fixture is generated by executing the unchanged 17 bytes at
actual TU1.5 `3803B0`, including its return, with Unicorn x86. The owned English
TU1.5 executable must have SHA-256
`21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`.
Vista, MCC and earlier Xbox executables are rejected. Original bytes and the
generated JSON remain local; this document and the generator are trackable.

From a repository containing the packaged files, with an owned executable:

```sh
.tools/python/bin/python tools/generate_native_lens_query_scalar_tu15.py \
  --repository "$PWD" --xbe /absolute/path/to/TU1.5/default.xbe \
  --fixture tests/fixtures/native_lens_query_scalar_tu15_original.json \
  --report /absolute/path/to/new/original-lens-scalar-report.json
```

Choose fresh output paths; the generator refuses to replace previous evidence.
The generator uses the repository's `tools/reference/halo2-decompiled/tools/xbe.py`
and the installed Unicorn Python package. Record both inputs, the Python runtime,
Unicorn module/native library, generator and output hashes in the execution
receipt. A missing executable returns77; a present wrong executable returns1.

The initial scalar at `532098/4` comes from the real loader-zero tail of `.data`.
It begins at the exclusive end of the separate `52DFD8/40C0` query owner.
The complete original body reads immutable `46A0C4/4` (`8180803b`) and performs
one scalar store. No scalar result, instruction, service or callback is supplied.
The fixture includes complete GP/XMM/flags, source PCs, the one store and the
unchanged adjacent query-bank control. The native test compares these results
and checks cold factory ownership, native backing, exact bounds and restoration.

Configure `HALO2_TU15_GAMEPLAY_XBE` to the owned executable. The asset-free
`native_tu15_lens_query_scalar_ownership` CTest requires no original files;
`original_tu15_lens_query_scalar` returns77 if either required local input is
missing, and1 for a malformed or mismatched present fixture. Neither test
constructs a Physics World or device. Original constructor scheduling, live
native query results and Vulkan appearance remain separate validation gates.
